finding: The reload driver clicked the fixture Open panel control but discarded its FRONTEND_RPC callback before polling for the replacement panel. The source run therefore could not identify whether the request was delivered or accepted. The old worker and panel were retired, a replacement worker appeared, and no replacement panel target was observed. This change does not assign a cause to that native failure.
change: The reload path clears the fixture's stale reply, clicks the same trusted Open panel control, and observes its callback concurrently with the unchanged 150-attempt target poll. Callback outcome never gates replacement target or context acceptance. The driver records receipt, ok, opened, a fixed outcome category, monotonic click time, and the replacement worker's observed activation and running states at the click. The allowlist serializer carries these fields into the Scrape disk receipt on success and failure without raw reply, reason, error, URL, or token text. The unrelated initial-open path is restored to its prior behavior.
red_guard: The native harness guard failed at the actual reloadOwnedExtension-to-captureLifecycleEvidence seam when the callback fields were omitted by the serializer; expected open_refused, observed undefined.

review_of_011ce6f2.finding_1: The earlier implementation awaited the callback and rejected a non-opened response before target polling. It could suppress a valid replacement panel and reduced polling time. The repair observes the callback without awaiting it and restores the original target/context verdict and 150-attempt timing.
review_of_011ce6f2.finding_2: The focused CI command omitted the callback and receipt guards. It now runs native-panel-open-reply.test.mjs, native-reload-reply-seam.test.mjs, and profile-reload-capture.test.mjs. The existing full harness still runs in the main CI workflow.
review_of_011ce6f2.test_census: The reloadCase fixture moved from native-sidepanel-qa-harness.test.mjs to native-reload-fixture.mjs so the focused guard can drive the same real reloadOwnedExtension function. Existing Developer-mode, worker-retirement, duplicate-worker, context, native-click-failure, and pre-click-retirement cases remain in the original harness test. The earlier callback-refusal rejection case is intentionally replaced with acceptance assertions for refused, absent, malformed, and delayed callbacks because the review requires callback-independent target acceptance. A failed target discovery still asserts the callback class reaches the safe receipt. These cases also run in the focused seam test.
